## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`) at D = 0: electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Step 3 of `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`. Run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T from the run-5 calibration): B 0 → 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 µV, 1.166 K. Run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T): ride-down 10 → 0.3 T at 20 mT. Raw first, then onset (`sdh_onset`) and 1/B FFT (`sdh_fft`) against F_L and the model F(n) table (`tetralayer_fs_count/fs_count_b0`). Note: run 6's 0–1 T segment (50 mT) undersamples 7-T-scale tones below ~1 T — onset/FFT reads use B ≥ 1 T; the coarse segment is background only.

# Runs 6-7 raw: gain-divided Rxx(B), no background removal.
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run

spots = {}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for j, (fid, lab, FL) in enumerate(((6, "electron n = +3.2e12", 33.1),
                                    (7, "hole n = -1.2e12", 12.4))):
    r = open_run(f"data/{fid}")
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    i_med = np.median(np.abs(r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6))          # drain current, Ithaco -1e6
    Rxx = r.col("sr1_X") / i_med
    o = np.argsort(B)
    spots[fid] = (B[o], Rxx[o], i_med, lab, FL)
    ax[j].plot(B[o], Rxx[o], lw=0.6)
    ax[j].set_title(f"run {fid} — {lab} (I = {i_med*1e9:.1f} nA)")
    ax[j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[j].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ω)")
    print(f"run {fid}: complete={not r.interrupted}, T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K, "
          f"|I_tg|max {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA, "
          f"|I_bg|max {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA, "
          f"sr1 |X|max {np.abs(r.col('sr1_X')).max()*1e6:.1f} of 50 uV FS")
fig.tight_layout()

# Runs 6-7: onset + 1/B FFT vs F_L and the model F(n) templates.
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, sdh_fft
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs, abab_mstar, abca_mstar

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for j, fid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    B, Rxx, i_med, lab, FL = spots[fid]
    m = B >= (1.0 if fid == 6 else 0.3)          # run 6: 10 mT segment only (Nyquist)
    on = sdh_onset(Rxx[m], B[m], r_full_scale=50e-6 / i_med)
    print(f"===== run {fid} ({lab}), F_L = {FL} T =====")
    print(on.summary())
    cutoff = max(on.onset_b, 1.0 if fid == 6 else 0.93)  # run 7: raise above onset until slow tones stabilize
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(Rxx[m][:, None], B[m], b_range=(cutoff, B.max()), bg_degree=5)
    s = spec[0] / spec[0].max()
    ax[j].plot(freqs, s, lw=0.8)
    ax[j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", label=f"F_L = {FL} T")
    ax[j].set_xlim(0, 45); ax[j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[j].set_ylabel("FFT (norm)")
    ax[j].set_title(f"run {fid} FFT, cutoff {cutoff:.2f} T")
    ax[j].legend()
fig.tight_layout()

# Model templates at the two spot densities (fs_count_b0; n in m^-2)
print("\nmodel F(n) [T] at the spot densities:")
for n12 in (3.2, -1.2):
    ms = abab_mstar(n12 * 1e16)
    Ft, mt = abca_mstar(n12 * 1e16)
    print(f"  n = {n12:+.1f}e12: ABAB " + ", ".join(f"{F:.2f} (m*{m:.3f})" for F, m in ms)
          + f"  |  ABCA {Ft:.2f} (m*{mt:.3f})")

**Read (runs 6–7):** Electron side is decisively the fan side. Run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T): strong QO with onset **≤ 1.0 T** (carrying tone censored at the valid-record edge — quality is good); dominant tone **7.3 T sits exactly on the model ABAB light branch** (7.31 T at this n), with a comb at 14.8 / 22.3 / 29.4 / 43.7 / 58.6 T all flaggable as harmonics of 7.3. The classification fork the spot check cannot close: **29.4 T** is simultaneously ≈ 4×7.3 *and* a heavy-tone candidate (model ABAB heavy 25.78 T; {7.3, 29.4} sums to 36.7 T = 1.11×F_L — a single global rescale closes the Luttinger sum, partition 0.20/0.80 vs model 0.22/0.78); **22.3 T** is likewise ≈ 3×7.3 *and* a heavy candidate at scale 0.87 (sum 0.89×F_L, partition 0.25/0.75). Per the investigation's harmonic screen, the ratio alone must not decide — the **n-trajectory does**: harmonics track k·f_light(n) (collapsing toward 0 as the light pocket empties below ~1×10¹²), a real heavy tone rises toward F_L. No unrescaled tone at F_L itself → ABCA singleton disfavored at this density, pending the global scale pin. Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T): the designed near-CNP exception-regime preview — tones 4.7 / 6.6 / 9.4 T, consistent with the close balanced pair (model 5.86/6.54 T, split < δF ≈ 0.8 T — not resolvable), uninformative for the call, as priced. **Next: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0** (`landau-fan-vti`, investigation Step 4) — per-column FFT across n disambiguates harmonic vs heavy and pins the global scale.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — the stacking-call dataset

> **05:29** · LF electron D=0: n +3.2 -> +0.8e12 (76 pts), B 1 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (109 rows, d(1/B)=1/120, Nyq 60 T), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s = 6 tau, ends at 10 T · **ETA ~11:44** (≈6h15m)

**Why now** (`tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4; spot-check read in ana runs 6–7): run 6 resolved a tone on the ABAB light branch (7.3 T at n = +3.2×10¹²) plus heavy-tone candidates (22.3 / 29.4 T) that are each degenerate with harmonics of 7.3 at a single density. The per-column FFT's **n-trajectory** is the discriminator: harmonics track k·f_light(n) → collapse toward 0 at low n; a real ABAB heavy tone rises toward F_L as the light pocket empties (model: heavy = 8.29 T ≈ F_L at n = 0.8×10¹²); an ABCA singleton stays pinned at F_L. One fan closes the fork and pins the global lever-arm scale via the Luttinger sum.

**Design (floored per `landau-fan` step 1; this is the proposal, no cheaper variant deferred):**
- **Fast axis**: n = +3.2 → +0.8×10¹² cm⁻², 76 pts (Δn = 3.2×10¹⁰), D = 0, run-5 cal. Ray-Nyquist at B_lo = 1 T: Δn_ray = 9.7×10¹⁰ → **3.0 samples/ray** (≥2 floor, at prefer-3). Gates span (Vtg, Vbg) = (+0.296…+0.984, +0.276…+1.166) V — inside validators.
- **Slow axis**: B = 1.0 → 10 T **uniform in 1/B**, 109 rows, Δ(1/B) = 1/120 T⁻¹ → **Nyquist F = 60 T** (covers heavy-2nd-harmonic 59 T at 2/period; F_L-breakdown tone ~37 T at 3.3; measured tones 29.4/22.3/7.3 at ≥4). **B_lo = 1.0 T**: run 6's onset is censored at the valid-record edge (onset ≤ 1.0 T) so every row carries signal; lowering B_lo would balloon N_B and the n-floor without being needed — per-column δF = 1/(1/1 − 1/10) = **1.11 T** separates every claim-critical pair (heavy vs F_L gap ≥ 2.4 T down to n = 1.2×10¹²). Light-tone ≥5-period floor holds for n ≳ 2.6×10¹² (f ≥ 5.6 T); below that the light tone is read at reduced period count — hedged, not claimed. B_hi = 10 T buys the heavy tone its max amplitude and the B-window breakdown split.
- **Acquisition inherited from run 6** (spot check hands the fan its sampling/settling/sensitivity): sr1 sens 50 µV (5 kΩ FS at 10 nA), drive 1 V, τ = 0.3 s with **fast_delay = 1.8 s = 6τ** (per-column-SdH settling band, base step 7). Dynamic range: worst corner is low-n × high-B (n = 0.8×10¹² at 10 T, ν ≈ 3.3, QH peaks); anchor run 7's 583 Ω at |n| = 1.2×10¹²/10 T → claim-carrying columns (n ≥ 1.2×10¹²) have ~8× headroom; the extreme corner may clip and is truncated per column by `r_full_scale` in analysis — sized to protect the claim columns, trade stated.
- **Coverage trade**: no hole-side fan — the reachable hole window (to −1.27×10¹², TG −0.3 V limit) sits inside the near-CNP exception regime (run 7: pair split < δF); a hole fan would be ~5 h for a resolvability-limited read. Full electron coverage instead.
- **Price** (calibrated: 0.1 s/pt read overhead from run 5; 0.137 T/min ramp): 8284 pts × 1.9 s = 4.4 h grid + 66 min traverse + 7 min initial ramp + ~5 min turnarounds ≈ 5.7 h → **realistic ≈ 6 h 15 m** (+8% session-evidence margin). Ends at **10 T** with gates parked at 0 — the LK mass split (`temperature-dependence-vti` Flavor B) or the close-out ride-down starts from there; no re-traverse.
- **Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed `--next --follow`): **first 2 rows (~6 min)** — column layout, signal fraction, leakage < 1 nA, T at base; **~1.5 h (row ~35, B ≈ 1.4 T)** — partial per-column FFT: light-tone branch tracking across n; **~3.5 h (B ≈ 2.7 T)** — heavy-candidate trajectory read, continue/abort call (abort ≈ `nb-collab interrupt`; partial fan keeps its rows). Leak guard trips the station at 1 nA.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0; n +3.2 -> +0.8e12 (76 pts fast) x B 1 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (109 rows slow) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D0 = 0.0
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 0.8, 76)            # 1e12 cm^-2, high -> low; dn = 3.2e10 (3.0 samples/ray at 1 T)
Ds = D0 * np.ones(len(ns))
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 at D = {D0:+.2f}; Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V; roundtrip end = {calc_nD(Vtgs[-1], Vbgs[-1], CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- slow field axis: uniform in 1/B, 1.0 -> 10 T, d(1/B) = 1/120 (Nyquist F = 60 T; spot-check run 6 design) ---
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1.0, 0.1, 109)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() >= 1.0
print(f"B rows: {len(B_vec)}, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, d(1/B) = {(1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[-1])/(len(B_vec)-1):.6f} /T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff state, fan ramps to 1 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

# --- acquisition inherited from spot-check run 6: sens 50 uV (5 kOhm FS at 10 nA), drive 1 V, tau 0.3 s ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 1.0         # 6*tau per-column-SdH settling; slow_delay per base step 7
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V (expect 1.0); sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s; "
      f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s = 6 tau")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D = 0: n {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 (76 pts), "
                  f"B 1 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (109 rows, d(1/B)=1/120), sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s (6 tau); run-5 cal")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} to {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 (76 pts, paired n-line), '
              f'B = {B_vec[0]:.2f} to {B_vec[-1]:.2f} T uniform-1/B (109 rows); sens 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s = 6 tau; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
# field stays at 10 T deliberately — next step (LK mass split / ride-down) starts there; never re-traverse.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates parked (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
